_readme: 模擬目錄（唯一來源）。tools/build-catalogue.mjs 由此生成 site/index.html 的 SIMS、BLUEPRINT.md §6 及藍圖網頁 §6。同一單元內按課本章節次序排列；type: e = 實驗, c = 概念；star: 1 = 第一階段。ch 為牛津《活學物理》章節，帶 ? 者為推斷，待老師核對。術語依 reference/08_中英術語對照表.csv。

sims.dzh: 金屬塊 / 水，發熱器、温度計、電錶讀數，T-t 圖，熱損失
sims.den: Metal block or water, heater, thermometer, meter readings, T-t graph, heat loss

sims.zh: 熔化潛熱 / 汽化潛熱
sims.en: Specific latent heat of fusion / vaporisation
sims.dzh: 冰塊加熱、沸水，質量-時間圖
sims.den: Melting ice, boiling water, mass-time graph

sims.dzh: 注射器加壓，p-V 及 p-1/V 圖
sims.den: Syringe under pressure, p-V and p-1/V graphs

sims.zh: 氣壓定律 / 查理定律
sims.dzh: 水浴加熱，p-T 圖外推至 −273 °C（絕對零度）
sims.den: Water bath, p-T graph extrapolated to −273 °C (absolute zero)

sims.dzh: 顯微鏡視角，烟粒被空氣分子撞擊
sims.den: Microscope view, smoke particles hit by air molecules

sims.den: Two bodies reaching thermal equilibrium; Celsius vs Kelvin scales

sims.dzh: 分子視角：温度 = 平均動能，內能 = 動能 + 勢能，熱 = 轉移中的能量
sims.den: Molecular view: temperature as mean KE, internal energy as KE + PE, heat as energy in transfer

sims.dzh: 金屬棒温度分佈、對流、紅外輻射
sims.den: Temperature along a rod, convection currents, infra-red radiation

sims.zh: 物態變化時温度為何不變
sims.en: Why temperature stays constant during a change of state
sims.dzh: 能量去了分子勢能而非動能
sims.den: Energy goes into molecular PE, not KE

sims.dzh: 高速分子逃逸、蒸發致冷；沸騰在整體內發生
sims.den: Fast molecules escape, cooling by evaporation; boiling throughout

sims.dzh: 3D 分子盒，改變 T、V、N，即時顯示壓強及速率分佈
sims.den: 3D molecule box; vary T, V, N; live pressure and speed distribution

sims.dzh: 分子撞壁的動量變化 → 壓強，推導 pV = ⅓Nmc²
sims.den: Momentum change at the wall gives pressure; derive pV = ⅓Nmc²

sims.zh: 理想氣體方程 pV = nRT
sims.dzh: 三個氣體定律合一，任意固定一個變量
sims.den: Three gas laws in one; hold any variable fixed

sims.dzh: 速率分佈曲線、方均根速率
sims.den: Speed distribution curve, r.m.s. speed

sims.zh: 紙帶打點計時器 / 運動感應器
sims.dzh: 紙帶生成、剪帶貼圖、求加速度
sims.den: Generate tape, cut and chart, find acceleration

sims.dzh: 光閘 / 電磁釋放，s-t² 圖
sims.den: Light gate or electromagnet release, s-t² graph

sims.zh: 牛頓運動第二定律（小車＋斜面）
sims.dzh: 補償摩擦作用、砝碼加力，a-F、a-1/m 圖
sims.den: Friction-compensated runway, a-F and a-1/m graphs

sims.dzh: 米尺平衡、重心，加減砝碼；即 S4 的情景 1
sims.den: Balance a metre rule, centre of gravity, add masses; scene 1 of S4

sims.zh: 動量守恆（小車 / 氣墊導軌）
sims.dzh: 彈性、非彈性、爆炸三種，動量及動能表；與 S8 共用碰撞引擎
sims.den: Elastic, inelastic and explosion; momentum and KE tables; shares the S8 collision engine

sims.dzh: 向心力箭嘴、F-ω² 圖，切繩後沿切線飛出；與 S1 共用受力顯示
sims.den: Centripetal force arrow, F-ω² graph, tangential release; shares the S1 force display

sims.zh: 位移、速度變化的矢量運算
sims.en: Vector arithmetic: displacement and change in velocity
sims.dzh: S12 · 路徑編輯；距離 vs 位移、平均速率 vs 平均速度；Δv = v − u 三角形法；轉 90° 速率不變時 Δv = √2 v
sims.den: S12 · Path editor; distance vs displacement; Δv = v − u by triangle; 90° turn gives Δv = √2 v

sims.zh: 相對速度與參考座標系
sims.en: Relative velocity and frames of reference
sims.dzh: 規格以外，待老師定奪；與 S1 的轉盤觀察者視角共用機制
sims.den: Beyond the spec, pending teacher approval; shares the rotating-observer view of S1

sims.zh: 運動線圖與真實運動同步
sims.en: Motion graphs synced with real motion
sims.dzh: S7 · 2D 即可。由運動生成圖，或在 v-t 圖上拖畫線段驅動小車；切線斜率、線下面積陰影；位移與距離分開讀數
sims.den: S7 · Motion draws the graphs, or draw a v-t graph to drive the trolley; slope, area; displacement vs distance

sims.zh: 慣性與牛頓運動第一定律
sims.dzh: 規格以外，待老師定奪：無摩擦運動、桌布實驗
sims.den: Beyond the spec, pending teacher approval: frictionless motion, tablecloth pull

sims.zh: 摩擦的方向與極限摩擦
sims.en: Direction of friction and limiting friction
sims.dzh: S13 · 驅動輪接觸點摩擦向前；靜摩擦隨外力增至極限後跌至動摩擦
sims.den: S13 · Friction on a driving wheel points forward; static friction rises to its limit then drops to kinetic

sims.dzh: S11 · 阻力 ∝ v 或 v²；初速可高於終端速度；a 由 g 減至零
sims.den: S11 · Drag ∝ v or v²; start above terminal velocity; a falls from g to zero

sims.zh: 作用與反作用力對的辨識
sims.dzh: S5 · 每支力標「施力物 → 受力物」；點選高亮其反作用力；只看某物體受的力（孤立物體圖）；桌加速下降時重量與法向反作用力不再相等
sims.den: S5 · Every force labelled agent → receiver; click to highlight its partner; filter forces on one body (free-body diagram)

sims.dzh: S10 · 滑輪連掛重、兩接觸方塊、升降機內磅秤；張力 vs mg；整體法與隔離法並列
sims.den: S10 · Pulley and hanging mass, blocks in contact, scale in a lift; tension vs mg; whole-system vs isolated

sims.en: Forces on an inclined plane and resolution
sims.dzh: S6 · R = mg cos θ 與 mg 比較條；實際摩擦 vs 極限摩擦；tan θ = μ 剛好滑動；加水平外力時 R 改變；接觸力合成
sims.den: S6 · R = mg cos θ vs mg; actual vs limiting friction; R changes with an applied horizontal force

sims.en: Rigid-body equilibrium, centre of gravity and toppling
sims.dzh: S4 · 米尺與支點、鉸接橫桿與牆、可傾斜的箱；作用線與垂直距離；力偶；重心在物體外；支撐面與重心投影，tan θ = b / 2h
sims.den: S4 · Metre rule, hinged beam, tilting box; line of action and perpendicular distance; couple; base area and CG projection

sims.zh: 能量轉換與機械能守恆
sims.en: Energy conversion and conservation of mechanical energy
sims.dzh: S9 · 軌道編輯器；能量堆疊條（動能、重力勢能、內能）；不同斜度同高度落底速率相同；參考水平面可拖動；W = Fs cos θ
sims.den: S9 · Track editor; stacked energy bars; same speed at the bottom for any slope; movable reference level

sims.zh: 碰撞與動量守恆（含二維與衝擊力）
sims.dzh: S8 · 總動量與總動能分開顯示；完全彈性至完全非彈性連續調節；二維碰撞矢量圖；硬地板 vs 軟墊 F-t 圖面積相同
sims.den: S8 · Total momentum and KE shown separately; elastic to inelastic; 2D vector diagram; equal F-t areas

sims.zh: 拋體運動：水平與垂直的獨立性
sims.dzh: S2 · 3D + 側視 + 俯視三窗同步；兩球同時落地；頻閃模式；最高點 vy = 0 但 vx 不變；g 可選 1.6 / 3.7 / 9.81
sims.den: S2 · 3D, side and top views in sync; two balls land together; strobe mode; at the top vy = 0 but vx unchanged

sims.zh: 圓周運動：向心力的來源
sims.en: Circular motion: source of the centripetal force
sims.dzh: S1 · 水平轉盤、錐擺、傾斜彎道（μ 可調至零）；受力圖只畫真實的力，合力另一層顯示；轉盤觀察者視角標明非慣性座標系；剪斷繩沿切線離開。另加豎直圓周情景（規格以外）
sims.den: S1 · Turntable, conical pendulum, banked track; only real forces drawn, resultant on its own layer; cut the string

sims.zh: 引力場強度與平方反比定律
sims.en: Gravitational field strength and the inverse square law
sims.dzh: S14 · 距離由地心量起；r = 2R 時 g/4；月球、火星比較
sims.den: S14 · Distance from Earth's centre; g/4 at r = 2R; compare Moon and Mars

sims.dzh: S3 · 常設引力箭嘴與場強讀數；艙內磅秤讀數為零而引力仍在；軌道面傾角非零時星下點成 8 字；T = 24 h 反推 r ≈ 4.2 × 10⁷ m
sims.den: S3 · Gravity arrow always shown; cabin scale reads zero while gravity remains; tilted orbit traces a figure of 8

sims.en: Refraction and total internal reflection (glass block)
